ux.qa.blocked.title: Quality check not passed — {language}
ux.qa.blocked.body: The returned translation cannot be approved until these problems are solved.
ux.qa.ready.title: Quality check passed — {language}
ux.qa.ready.body: The translation has no blocking errors. Before it enters the manual a reviewer must approve it.
ux.qa.ready.todo: Enter the reviewer, tick «Confermo approvazione umana» and use «Approva traduzione».
ux.qa.reason.source_changed: The original text changed after the package was sent to the translator: this translation refers to an outdated version.
ux.qa.todo.source_changed: Cancel this job, generate a new package from the current text in Translation and create a new job.
ux.qa.reason.language: The returned file declares languages other than those expected for the {language}.
ux.qa.todo.language: Ask the translator for the correct file and upload it with «Riesegui controllo qualità (QA)».
ux.qa.reason.unit_set: The returned file does not match the package that was sent: {missing} segments missing, {extra} extra segments.
ux.qa.todo.unit_set: Ask the translator to work on the package file without adding or removing segments, then upload it again.
ux.qa.reason.empty: {n} segments are empty: the translation is incomplete.
ux.qa.reason.empty.one: 1 segment is empty: the translation is incomplete.
ux.qa.todo.empty: Ask the translator to complete them, then upload the file again with «Riesegui controllo qualità (QA)».
ux.qa.reason.linguistic: {n} segments were left identical to the original text or do not look written in the language expected for the {language}.
ux.qa.reason.linguistic.one: 1 segment was left identical to the original text or does not look written in the language expected for the {language}.
ux.qa.todo.linguistic: Ask the translator to translate them, then upload the file again with «Riesegui controllo qualità (QA)».
ux.qa.reason.technical: {n} segments have numbers, codes or formatting that differ from the original text.
ux.qa.reason.technical.one: 1 segment has numbers, codes or formatting that differ from the original text.
ux.qa.todo.technical: Technical values must match the original: fix the ones listed in the table below, then upload the file again.
ux.qa.reason.terminology: {n} segments do not use the approved terminology (strict terminology check on).
ux.qa.reason.terminology.one: 1 segment does not use the approved terminology (strict terminology check on).
ux.qa.todo.terminology: Fix the terms listed in the table below, then upload the file again.
ux.qa.reason.other_segments: {n} segments did not pass other checks.
ux.qa.reason.other_segments.one: 1 segment did not pass other checks.
ux.qa.todo.other_segments: Read the problem given for each segment in the table below.
ux.qa.reason.other: The check did not pass for an unrecognised reason.
ux.qa.todo.other: Open the technical details and forward them to the translator or to support.
ux.qa.seg.missing_segment: Segment missing from the returned file
ux.qa.seg.source_edited: The original text was edited inside the file
ux.qa.seg.numbers: Numbers differ from the original (original: {source} — translation: {target})
ux.qa.seg.codes: Codes differ from the original (original: {source} — translation: {target})
ux.qa.seg.near_identical: Almost identical to the original text
ux.qa.seg.identical: Identical to the original text: not translated
ux.qa.seg.wrong_language: Does not look written in the target language
ux.job.next.READY_TO_SEND: Send the package to the translator, then use «Segna inviato».
ux.job.next.SENT: When the translator starts you can use «Segna in traduzione»; when the file comes back, upload it with «Ricevi XLIFF + controllo qualità (QA)».
ux.job.next.IN_TRANSLATION: When you receive the translated file, upload it with «Ricevi XLIFF + controllo qualità (QA)».
ux.job.next.QA_BLOCKED: Fix the returned file and upload it with «Riesegui controllo qualità (QA)».
ux.job.next.QA_READY: Enter the reviewer, confirm the human approval and use «Approva traduzione».
ux.job.next.CANCELLED: To translate the current text, generate a new package in Translation and create a new job.
ux.job.done.approved.body: The translation entered the manual and the translation memory. The approval record and the confirmed memory are below.
ux.job.not_available.title: Action not available right now
ux.job.not_available.body: The job for the {language} is in state «{state}»: the action «{action}» cannot be run now.
ux.job.no_job.title: No job given
ux.job.no_job.body: Give the job to act on: you find it in the «Job» column of the table above.
ux.job.not_found.title: Job not found
ux.job.not_found.body: There is no job «{job}» in this project. Check the jobs table above.
ux.job.error.title: The action was not run
ux.job.cancel.confirm.title: Cancel the job for the {language}?
ux.job.cancel.confirm.body: A cancelled job can no longer receive translations. Everything recorded so far is kept.
ux.job.cancel.confirm.todo: To translate the current text you will then generate a new package and create a new job.
ux.no_project.title: No project open
ux.no_project.body: Open or create a project from the Overview to continue.
ux.pkg.no_langs.title: Target languages are missing
ux.pkg.no_langs.body: The project has no target languages: ERYLOS does not know which languages to prepare the translator files for.
ux.pkg.no_langs.todo: Add the languages in Settings › Project, then generate the packages again.
ux.pkg.unapproved.title: {n} content items are not approved yet
ux.pkg.unapproved.title.one: 1 content item is not approved yet
ux.pkg.unapproved.body: Translator packages are prepared only from approved content, so nobody translates text that can still change.
ux.pkg.unapproved.archived: Some of them are archived: even though they are not in the manual, they block the packages until they are approved.
ux.pkg.unapproved.todo: Open each item, complete it and have it approved (or send it for review), then generate the packages again.
ux.pkg.empty.title: The manual has no chapters
ux.pkg.empty.body: There is nothing to translate: import or write the manual in Content, then approve it.
ux.pkg.not_found.title: Content to translate not found
ux.pkg.not_found.body: «{object}» does not exist in this project. Check what you asked to translate.
ux.pkg.done.title: {n} language packages created
ux.pkg.done.body: Each package contains only the work to translate for its language. Send it to the translator and record the job in Translation › Jobs & vendors.
ux.pkg.error.title: The packages could not be generated
ux.pkg.error.body: An unexpected problem occurred. The reason is in the technical details: forward it to support if it happens again.
